page.overview:
Who is Bear Mountain Lord?

The Bear Mountain Lord looked valiant and courageous, and had a brawny body.

General Yin summoned his allies the Bear Mountain Lord and the Bull Scholar after capturing the monk Tang Sanzang and his attendants. The demons ate the two attendants, but were unable to harm Sanzang because of his holiness.

With his immense strength, the Bear Mountain Lord was able to ford water and break down trees. He was also wise and could predict the weather.
